cases.input: One project serves two products with a 60/40 cost allocation.
cases.expect: One project cost fact is deduplicated and allocated once by the product view.

cases.input: Four teams contribute effort to one project.
cases.expect: Team decomposition is shown separately from product allocation.

cases.input: A portfolio contains a program and also directly references its project.
cases.expect: The project source facts are counted once.

cases.input: Product allocation and team-effort decomposition are added together.
cases.expect: The roll-up is rejected as double counting across orthogonal dimensions.

cases.input: A scenario benefit projection is imported as realized benefit.
cases.expect: The authoritative view rejects the scenario result.
